options.name: Commoner (Peasant)
options.description: The lowest on the hierarchy of social class, peasants are commoners who labor for a living. They typically don't own any land, instead paying rent to landlords (usually minor nobility) in exchange for getting to live on the land and cultivate it.

grants.valuePrompt: Reflect how the character perceives their place in the social hierarchy, and the lessons they've learned as a result.
